extra.reason: Recorded user-approved commerce scope, obsolete game-specific APIs, and lack of compatibility constraints in RFC 0001 and progress.

Removed SubaccountsResource and ReceivesResource, both runtime routes, queueReceives, deferred watcher/allocation diagnostics and obsolete game-route tests. Recorded removal and commerce scope in RFC 0001, replaced deferred-subaccount changeset with a breaking API removal changeset, and reduced progress to current context. pnpm build passed; full pnpm test passed under actual Node 22.23.2. Initial Node 26 run exposed a local SQLite ABI mismatch, resolved by using the project Node version without dependency changes.

Recipient chain projections now come only from account_info reconciliation; confirmed sends no longer mutate recipient balance/frontier, with duplicate and restart replay coverage through the default forwarding path.

Aligned the SDK/model invoice request with HTTP validation, normalized raw or decimal XNO strings through nano-core NanoAmount, rejected invalid amount/policy/metadata input with structured 400 errors, and passed full build and test gates under Node 22.

Verified clean frozen-lockfile install compiles pinned OWS 56184be to the Node native binding and imports indexed derive/sign APIs; confirmed readiness probes derivation plus canonical state-block signing; documented actual package versions, supported targets, native build requirements, and Docker toolchain; custody tests pass and key isolation remains intact.

Upgraded all workspace/example nano-core ranges and exact root override to 3.6.0, nano-rspow-node ranges and root override to 0.17.2, and lockfile to those exact releases. Registry metadata confirms the published versions and nano-core 3.6.0 peer range includes nano-rspow-node 0.17.x. Resolved APIs compile in RaiFlow custody/RPC/runtime and the full workspace build and test suites pass on Node 22; pinned OWS 1.3.2/revision 56184be packaging and indexed derive/sign readiness were verified under .21.

Added nano.work config parsing and remote-first routing with local fallback. A shared nano-core WorkProvider is passed to RPC and both provider-backed and seed-backed custody engines; local nano-rspow generation runs in a child process and remote/local nonces are validated against the canonical threshold. Added config, RPC routing, custody delegation, remote validation/fallback tests. Full build/tests pass and a native 0.17.2 isolated generation/validation smoke check passed.

Added SQLite-backed per-address leases with monotonically increasing fencing tokens, a shared renewing executor for sends and receives, representative-update serialization, and recovery of abandoned processing receives. Workspace build and full test suite pass under Node 22.

Added private SQLite send-block intents that persist exact signed JSON, work, expected hash, frontier, and resulting balance before broadcast. Retries and restarts reuse the saved intent, reconcile Old block by querying its hash, recover queued and published sends, and leave ambiguous outcomes nonterminal. Send idempotency now collapses concurrent retries and rejects changed payloads. Workspace build and 172-test suite pass on Node 22.

Receive recovery is enqueued during confirmed-block ingestion, processing tasks recover under expiring account leases, exact receive blocks persist before publish, and source-send confirmation remains distinct from receive-block confirmation. Build and full test suite pass.

Canonical deposits are durably deduplicated by source block hash, independently of invoice matching, and queryable by application account key or managed/watched account. Confirmed receive/change blocks are excluded. Build and full test suite pass.

Confirmed-send ingest now atomically commits the unique deposit, invoice payment and lifecycle transition, persisted events, and owned receive-task intent. Replays repair partial prior writes and deduplicate contributions/events; injected event failure rolls back the transaction. Production wiring requires this store with persistent deposits. Full build and tests pass.
Implemented and validated bounded persistent account-history recovery and acknowledged account-filtered subscriptions.
Implemented and validated unique persisted invoice targets and explicit application-reference semantics.
Implemented and validated durable payment dispositions and safe late/unmatched payment handling.
Implemented and validated configured invoice expiry and guarded terminal transitions.

Implemented and documented the shared inbound amount policy. Final pnpm build and pnpm test both pass, including exact-boundary SQLite replay, dust rejection, receive discovery and raised-minimum operation recovery coverage. Storage retention remains tracked in RaiFlow-7w6.28.
Invoice settlement now uses the durable shared send pipeline and passed workspace build and tests
Transactional event-to-webhook outbox and lease recovery are implemented and verified
Persisted webhook attempts, retries, restart recovery and namespace matching are implemented and verified
Added public-interface SQLite recovery coverage for all listed commerce and restart scenarios; pnpm build and pnpm test pass.
Converged the SDK on accounts, invoices, sends, and durable global events; removed misleading and duplicate SDK surfaces, documented explicit references, and verified full build/test gates.
Rebuilt the three integration examples on the supported SDK with server-side credentials, idempotency, durable event cursors and partial/excess/late payment handling; full build and test suite pass.

Runtime, bootstrap, and in-memory stores now use canonical invoice/payment/event contracts directly; legacy adapters and model types are removed. SQLite recovery scenarios and full workspace build/test pass.
Consolidated RPC calls, startup health probes, runtime watcher observation, authentication, failover, and work generation behind nano-core public transport seams; build and test gates pass.

Added an atomic deposit refund reservation linked to the existing durable send pipeline, explicit destination and idempotency requirements, per-deposit amount caps, API/SDK support, docs, and managed/invoice source coverage; full build and tests pass.

Reconciled README, roadmap, progress, published runtime docs, and RFCs with the current /v1 commerce contract, explicit refunds, receive admission, webhook outbox, recovery, and the remaining storage-retention gap.
Implemented keep-all inbound storage budgets, pause/retry semantics, health reporting, config, docs, and passing validation
All child work completed and epic acceptance criteria verified
